core_question: My router is completely unresponsive, how do I factory reset it? (secondary: How do I get a broken key piece out of a lock?)
answer_summary: Locate the small recessed reset button on the router and hold it down with a pin for roughly 10 seconds until the lights flash, restoring factory defaults.; after the topic shift: Insert a broken key extractor tool (or two fine hook picks) alongside the snapped key fragment and gently pull it out along the pins, without pushing it deeper.
persona: impatient and curt; texting quickly with typos here and there
